description_en: Queries the system tools supported by the MCP service
description_zh: 查询 MCP 服务支持的系统工具
name: ListApiMcpServerSystemTools

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为 100。默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of data entries to skip
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If a query does not return all results, pass the NextToken value returned from the previous query to continue retrieving results
parameters.help_zh:
下一个查询开始 Token，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 参数值。

第一次查询不需要提供本参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的 NextToken 值以继续查询
parameters.name: next_token
